title: block-no-verify telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the block-no-verify guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "block-no-verify". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string.

tool.description: Always "Bash" — this guard matches only Bash tool calls.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject `Bash:<first-token>` with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed. NEVER the full command or its arguments.

form.description: The bypass form when blocked: "no-verify" | "hooksPath" | "hook-manager-env". Empty string when the command was allowed (status ok).
